hooks.name: Documentation Synchronizer
hooks.description: When the agent stops working, verify that all affected documentation has been updated.

action.prompt: Before finalizing, check documentation synchronization: (1) Are affected specifications still consistent with the implementation? (2) Is IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS.md updated with current progress? (3) Is CHANGELOG.md updated if user-visible behavior changed? (4) Are ADR references correct? (5) Are architecture diagrams current? Report any gaps that need to be addressed before the work can be considered complete.
